part.text:
Fixed the overflow by widening `lpGetInteger` results (flags, deltas, counts, skip lengths) to `int64_t` in `src/t_stream.c`.

Root cause: large ms/seq deltas were truncated into `int`, producing wrong `currid` values and causing XTRIM MINID to delete entries above the threshold.

Validated with:
- `unit/type/stream` — all pass, including the big-delta MINID regression.
- `unit/type/stream-cgroups` — all pass.
